name: fib_le_pow
prelude:
def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n + 2 => fib n + fib (n + 1)
statement: theorem fib_le_pow (n : Nat) : fib n ≤ 2 ^ n
proofs:
have h : ∀ n, fib n ≤ 2 ^ n ∧ fib (n + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [fib]
    | succ n ih =>
      refine ⟨ih.2, ?_⟩
      rw [fib, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.pow_succ]
      have := ih.1
      have := ih.2
      rw [Nat.pow_succ] at this
      omega
  exact (h n).1
  induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | ind n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => simp [fib]
    | 1 => simp [fib]
    | k + 2 =>
      have h1 := ih k (by omega)
      have h2 := ih (k + 1) (by omega)
      rw [fib, Nat.pow_succ, Nat.pow_succ]
      rw [Nat.pow_succ] at h2
      omega
